units.text: The WHO 2025 World Malaria Report recognizes 47 countries and one territory as malaria free, according to a secondary source citing the report.

citations.title: WHO Certifies Countries as Malaria Free in Face of Persistent Antimalarial Drug Resistance | Contagion Live

judgement.reason: The Contagion Live passage, a secondary source citing the report, states the WHO 2025 World Malaria Report recognizes 47 countries and one territory as malaria free.
